_doc: A Ø10 mm aluminium round bar, as a ready size of the round bar family (profile-round-bar holds the family and how to give any other size). It has no maker's sheet: every dimension is the nominal one stock is sold by, so measure the bar in hand, and its area, second moments, torsion constant and mass are worked out from its outline. The drawn outline leaves out nothing a round bar has.
name: profile-round-bar-al-10

family.rule: A round bar: a solid circle
family.source: the nominal size this set is named for: stock is sold by it, and no one maker's sheet is behind it
